name: polyfit
expr: p = polyfit([1 2 3 4], [1 4 9 16], 2); [pc, S, mu] = polyfit(x, y, 1); [yh, dl] = polyval(pc, 3, S, mu);
comment: Sig: p = polyfit(x,y,n); [p,S,mu] = polyfit(...); [y,delta] = polyval(p,x,S,mu). Covers default coeffs, mu = [mean(x); std(x,0)] centering/scaling, S.normr/S.df, and the polyval error estimate delta = normr/sqrt(df)*sqrt(1+rowSum((V/R).^2)). S.R sign convention is intentionally not fingerprinted (Cholesky vs MATLAB qr-R differ in row sign; R'R identical so delta matches).
